execution.live_capture: physical Linux host; digest-pinned official Mosquitto and NATS targets on owned internal Docker networks
execution.toolchain: Rust 1.98 in a temporary two-CPU/four-GiB build container
execution.mqtt: 3.1.1 anonymous isolated fixture, in-memory persistent-session seed, no disk persistence
execution.nats: core protocol-1, disposable account and gewy.> permissions, max_payload 1024
execution.nats_info_updates: retained in raw bytes and decoded transcript; bounded to four INFO frames per exchange for expectation matching
execution.docker_public_pull_configuration: separate empty configuration after existing Docker login token was rejected as expired; original credentials untouched

exclusion_reasons.dev-1: unsupported-version readiness oracle was not suitable for this broker; switched to valid clean-session readiness and explicit empty-ID refusal
exclusion_reasons.dev-2: real MQTT session-resume and nonzero-PUBACK-ID production rule failures
exclusion_reasons.dev-3: development rule used unsupported TCP prefix2 qualifier; corrected to existing byte predicates
exclusion_reasons.dev-4: MQTT passed; NATS readiness oracle did not handle asynchronous INFO
exclusion_reasons.run-1..3: successful preliminary captures excluded after moving negative bodies before the real error and adding a post-error recovery message

before_fix.kind: actual Mosquitto responses reconciled against kernel bytes and existing package stages
package_failures: data package protocols/mqtt/connect/main.gewy phase receive_connack: observed {}, expected {32833}; check packet candidates versus framed response
data package protocols/mqtt/publish/main.gewy phase receive_puback: observed {}, expected {32833}; check packet candidates versus framed response

fixes.problem: success predicate accepted only new-session CONNACK 20 02 00 00, missing resumed-session 20 02 01 00
fixes.fix: add exact resumed-session success alternative; preserve refusal/reserved/truncated negatives

fixes.problem: PUBACK predicate hard-coded packet identifier zero and missed real identifier 7
fixes.fix: require PUBACK type/length and observed ID bytes; fixed client separately validates nonzero exact ID, production candidate does not correlate IDs

verification.scope: Gewyvern library and six targeted integration suites, plus native-validation and project-status closure suites; not a whole-workspace test or release gate

cleanup.note: Before/after inventories compare all captures before temporary build-container removal; final container inventory differs only by removal of that owned build container. Previous-family control and preliminary/development runs are excluded from final messaging totals.

limitations: one physical host/kernel, not cross-host qualification
no TLS decryption, arbitrary protocol detection, vulnerability-detection or performance claim
bounded server-stream oracle, not general TCP reassembly; client read chunks are not TCP packet boundaries
no request-side payload capture or process attribution; MQTT seed is setup only
MQTT 3.1.1 only, anonymous lab, no MQTT5/authentication/offline-queue/broker-crash durability certification
PUBACK production predicates are packet-prefix candidates, not nonzero-ID validation or request/ack correlation
NATS core only, no headers/JetStream/clusters/TLS; INFO/-ERR packet candidates do not establish successful login
